component.name: OpenConvert
component.summary: Convert PDF books to reflowable EPUB, on this computer

description.p: OpenConvert turns a PDF book into a reflowable EPUB 3.3 that reads well on any e-reader: paragraphs, headings, chapters, footnotes and images are recovered from the page layout, and every character of the text is accounted for.
Everything happens on your computer. Nothing is uploaded, there is no telemetry, and a conversion never uses the network. Optional AI assistance runs a small local model that you choose to install.
